title: Bagpipe jingles and settling back into jazz
summary: He plays pipes on jingles and records, does few trumpet jobs now, and is happiest back at jazz and teaching.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I can't remember, one show I did or some band when --
Oh, I've done a lot of things, yeah.
Yeah, I remember being at some occasion where you played the bagpipes.

I've done a record with John Lennon and with this punk rock singer, what's her name? Patti Smith. On her last album. I generally just try to play traditional stuff but I've done an awful lot of jingles. They had one with Peter Sellers dressed as a Scotsman and that was me

playing the pipes. And they have another one for British Airlines showing a Scotsman over on a hill, it was me playing the pipes. I do a lot of jingles. Probably more jingles now on bagpipe than I do on trumpet. I'm pretty much out of that area. I do about two a year on trumpet.
And I'm not sorry, I don't miss it at all.
Not at this stage of the game. It's nice to sort of sit in the sun.
I don't need that much money now. I teach and play the kind of stuff I like to play. I'm back where I started, playing jazz again, and I'm the happiest I've ever been.
It's been a nice circle for us, you know.

Sure, we started the hard way and made it through a very lucrative scene when the records were very popular, a lot of records were made. At the time we really needed it, when our children were growing up.
That's right. We were in on the start of television and tape.
Our careers have sort of paralleled along that line.
Half the dates I did were with you.
Sure. It's been a really nice thing
to see. Now as we settle down, all the young fellows have got to have a chance, we get back to playing a little jazz and teaching and doing some of the things we like to do.
